0d49a1.title: PrismLife public surface map
0d49a1.content:
## Scope and evidence
- Exact approved target: `https://prismlife.com/`.
- Read-only GET mapping performed for `/`, `/investor-relations.html`, `/governance.html`, `/ipo-kit.html`, `/annual-reports.html`, `/annual-returns.html`, and `/general-meetings.html`; each returned `200 text/html`.
- `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, and `/site.webmanifest` returned `404` (the latter is nevertheless referenced in root HTML).
- Root headers: `Server: AmazonS3`; `Via`/`X-Cache` identify CloudFront. Root response was `200`, `Content-Length: 91033`, and ETag `"5166615670d71c8e12ae94d38dc6ed3f"`.

## Reachable routes
- Main navigation consists of `/` (also `/index.html`) with client-only anchors: `#home`, `#brands`, `#culture`, `#investors`, `#newsroom`, `#contact`.
- Investor portal: `/investor-relations.html` (board), `/governance.html`, `/ipo-kit.html`, `/annual-reports.html`, `/annual-returns.html`, `/general-meetings.html`.
- Governance anchors: `/governance.html#annual-reports`, `#annual-returns`, `#policies`, `#general-meetings`.
- IPO anchors: `/ipo-kit.html#udrhp-section`, `#supporting-section`.

## Download/document surface
- Governance exposes `Annual_Report_FY22.pdf` through `Annual_Report_FY26.pdf` and `Annual%20Return%20FY%2021.pdf` through `Annual%20Return%20FY%2025.pdf`; its policy documents are linked as same-origin PDFs, including CSR, risk management, whistleblower, archival, materiality, subsidiary, director familiarization, remuneration, conduct/trading/fair-disclosure policies.
- `/general-meetings.html` links the `Shareholders%20Meeting/` hierarchy of notice, transcript, voting-result, presentation, and bonus-issuance PDFs for 2022–2026.
- `/ipo-kit.html` exposes `Project%20SKYE%20%20Consolidated%20UDRHP-%20I%20(Public%20filing)%20-%2029062026.pdf`, `Project%20SKYE-Industry%20report.pdf`, `FY%2023.pdf`/`FY%2024.pdf`/`FY%2025.pdf` variants, `OYO%20Vacation%20Homes%20Holding%20BV_FY%20{2023,2024,2025}.pdf`, and the `Material%20Subsidiaries/` PDF hierarchy (Admiral Strand, Belvilla entities, DanCenter, G6, IBL, ITHS SG, OYO Netherlands/UK/Hotels/Homes/Rooms/Technology/Vacation Homes, Oravel Singapore, PT OYO Rooms Indonesia, Traum Ferienwohnungen).

## Client/static surface and technology
- Same-origin custom scripts: `/js/main.js`, `/js/globe.js`, `/js/plugins.js`; vendor scripts: `/js/vendor/modernizr-3.6.0.min.js`, `/js/vendor/jquery-3.6.0.min.js`; styles: `/css/normalize.css`, `/css/slick.css`, `/scss/main.css`.
- Client uses jQuery 3.6.0, Modernizr 3.6.0, Slick carousel (in plugins), Three.js 0.160.0, Globe.gl 2.45.2, and TopoJSON client 3. Root JS has no same-origin API/XHR/fetch endpoints. `/js/globe.js` fetches only the external `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/countries-50m.json` (not accessed because off-scope).
- Root has an HTML5 video modal and uses same-origin rotating images `./img/st1.png` … `./img/st5.png`; no submitted forms, inputs, selects, textareas, form actions, request-body parameters, or query parameters were found across mapped pages.
- Public outbound references (not followed): Google Fonts, jQuery CDN, unpkg, jsDelivr, YouTube/youtu.be, LinkedIn, Instagram, `madecomfy.com.au`, `studioprestige.fr`, and `mailto:` contacts.

## Raw inspection artifacts
- Local raw response bodies/headers retained during task under `/tmp/prismlife.html`, `/tmp/prism_investor-relations.html`, `/tmp/prism_governance.html`, `/tmp/prism_ipo-kit.html`, `/tmp/prism_annual-reports.html`, `/tmp/prism_annual-returns.html`, `/tmp/prism_general-meetings.html`, and corresponding JS/header files.

- `http://www.test.leisure-partners.net/` — referenced by the redirect but DNS resolution failed (`Name or service not known`) over permitted HTTP.

91bbd0.title: Weddingz wildcard discovery: reachable CMS and host redirects
91bbd0.content:
Read-only discovery within `http://*.weddingz.in/`.

## Host inventory
- `http://www.weddingz.in/` → 302 `Location: http://weddingz.in/` (apex is outside wildcard and Scope proxy returns 403 when directly requested).
- `http://m.weddingz.in/` → 301 `Location: https://m.weddingz.in/`; HTTPS destination was not followed because approval is HTTP-only.
- `http://api.weddingz.in/` → 301 `Location: https://api.weddingz.in/`; HTTPS destination not followed for the same scope restriction.
- `http://media.weddingz.in/` → 403 XML from Amazon S3 behind CloudFront (`x-amz-bucket-region: ap-southeast-1`); directory listing not accessible. CMS pages reference assets under `https://media.weddingz.in/images/<timestamp>/<filename>`.
- `http://blog-cms.weddingz.in/` → 200 Apache/2.4.55, PHP/7.3.11, WordPress with custom `weddingz-blog-theme-master` theme; response sets `PHPSESSID`, uses `X-Frame-Options: sameorigin` and CSP `upgrade-insecure-requests`.

## CMS public surface

- Verified 200: `/category/wedding-venues/`, `/tag/banquet-halls-in-mumbai/`, `/?s=wedding`, and sampled post `/golden-leaf-banquet-malad-reviews-what-guests-loved/`.
- Page markup exposes 20+ category slugs, including `about-weddingz`, `bridal-and-grooms-wear`, `bridal-look`, `bridal-mehendi-and-makeup`, `bridal-wear`, `cities`, `communities`, `destination-wedding-blogs`, `mice-events`, `real-wedding-stories`, `real-weddings`, `special-offers`, `wedding-decor`, `wedding-ideas`, `wedding-photography`, `wedding-planning`, `wedding-planning-and-ideas`, `wedding-services`, `wedding-venues`, `wedding-vendors`.
- Public search form: GET action `/`, parameter `s`.
- Public comment form on post pages: POST `/wp-comments-post.php` (not submitted); fields `comment`, `author`, `email`, `url`, `wp-comment-cookies-consent`, `submit`, `comment_post_ID`, `comment_parent`.
- Feed links are disclosed at `/feed/`, `/comments/feed/`, `/<post-slug>/feed/`, `/category/<slug>/feed/`; direct unauthenticated fetches of global feeds returned 403.

## WordPress/admin/API routes
- `/wp-login.php` → 302 self-location (no credentials sent).
- `/xmlrpc.php`, `/wp-json/`, `/feed/`, `/comments/feed/` → 403.
- `/wp-json/wp/v2/{types,posts,categories,tags,pages}` disclosed/queried read-only and returns 401 JSON: `rest_not_logged_in` / `DRA: Only authenticated users can access the REST API.`
- `/robots.txt` is 200 and only contains `Disallow: /`; `/sitemap.xml` and `/wp-sitemap.xml` return 404.
- RSD is disclosed at `/xmlrpc.php?rsd`; Windows Live Writer manifest at `/wp-includes/wlwmanifest.xml`.
- Theme assets: `/wp-content/themes/weddingz-blog-theme-master/{style.css,assets/{css,images,js}}`; plugin assets disclose `wp-security-hardening` under `/wp-content/plugins/wp-security-hardening/modules/`; WordPress core static paths under `/wp-includes/` and jQuery scripts.

## Evidence
Raw response bodies and fetched assets are stored at `/tmp/weddingz-discovery/`; root page is `/tmp/weddingz_blog-cms.html`. Scope proxy journal IDs include root CMS `f7d7fe4d-db46-4b86-a47c-46a457d7ce84`, CMS endpoint sweep `47c4ff6e-d2a0-445a-afaf-07774dbfe0e2` through `b6f5fd72-f554-4985-a0ce-d8c55b26ca31`, mobile redirect `7e5f9742-1444-466e-b04b-014f1557bc54`, media `972682a9-acdd-4343-a419-4e902523419a`, and API redirect `395fbbf3-5a9a-46dd-90e2-745e0d8ee60d`.

## Gaps
The primary properties redirect to HTTPS but this assigned scope permits only `http://*.weddingz.in/`; do not follow without additional authorization. `weddingz.in` apex is not included in the wildcard and was blocked by Scope. - Captured evidence: `4276ee06-81e9-4c9b-9c2d-17ca3ccebc5e` (root); `133358fe-24cc-4260-a405-6f980aebf9cb` (robots); `f2a33cdb-0853-4200-9d68-e0d9da83ca0d` (sitemap); `c838539e-bfe0-406e-a057-f49ca5822e28` (security.txt).

Additional DNS-resolved in-scope hostname: `beta.innov8.work` → `52.11.77.228` (A record). Two `GET http://beta.innov8.work/` attempts through proxy timed out (10s and 20s respectively) with no HTTP status/body; capture IDs `8882db79-341d-4bb2-ba1d-733e1c782424`, `c195b180-6f43-4880-a6e1-5b60858ad291`.

Gap: content is only available at the HTTPS redirect destination, but HTTPS was not included in this child's exact assigned/approved target (`http://*.innov8.work/`), so it was not accessed. Add `https://*.innov8.work/` to approved scope and map it separately to obtain application routes/assets.

5cf7cc.title: DanCenter wildcard surface discovery
5cf7cc.content:
Scope assessed: `https://*.dancenter.dk/` using read-only GETs only. Publicly reachable canonical host is `www.dancenter.dk`; `https://dancenter.dk/` returned 403. Sitemap only contains host `www.dancenter.dk`.

Evidence retained under `/workspace/dancenter-recon/`:
- `google-sitemap.xml` / `sitemap-urls.txt`: 9,248 URLs. Major roots: 5,617 `sommerhus` paths, 2,139 `sverige`, 725 `norge`, 612 `tyskland`, 39 `blog`; route corpus includes geographic area and five-digit property ID pages.
- `root.html`, `housecube.html`, `property-js-schema.txt`, `housecube-analysis.txt`, `linked-endpoints-analysis.txt`, and individual response headers/bodies.

Public application map:
- Main pages: `/`, `/sog.html`, `/google-sitemap`, `/robots.txt`, `/favoritter`, `/husnr/`, seasonal/theme/info/blog, country/area/property routes, e.g. `/sommerhus/bornholm/sommerodde/12343/`.
- Search wrapper: `/sog.html?hc-region=4458` embeds `GET /housecube?cookies=1&country=dk&region=4458`.
- Search criteria form includes: `country`, `region`, `hotel-region`, `hotels`, `period`, `arrival-delta`, `persons`, `bedrooms`, `pets`, `facility` (repeated), `rebate-pct`, `max-price`, `distance-coast`, `distance-grocer`, `smoking`, `stars`, `rating`, `bathrooms`, and `sortby`. Facilities observed: pool inside/outside, water park, spa, sauna, view, fireplace, internet, boat, dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, satellite dish, new house, car charger, free cancellation, cleaning/electricity included, big/activity/energy/fishing/hotel/house.
- Search async routes disclosed in JS (not invoked): POST `/housecube/dancenter18/search`, `/housecube/dancenter18/calendar?calendar=`, `/housecube/dancenter18/area-browse?search_area_node_id=&q=`, `/housecube/dancenter18/house-popup?houseid=`, `/housecube/misc/check-house?houseid=`, and `/housecube/dancenter18/last-minute`. JS also exposes telemetry (`/srch`, `/hview`, `/click`, `/ua`, `/gatest`) and state-changing favorite endpoint `/housecube/favorites/modify` (not accessed).
- Property-page AJAX routes disclosed but not invoked: POST `/pubweb/vishus12/price?houseid=&period=&persons=&pets=&bedrooms=&bathrooms=&smoking=&retries=`; `/pubweb/vishus12/calendar?houseid=&hotel=&calendar=`; `/pubweb/vishus12/ratings.ajax?houseid=&type=rating|areatext`; `/pubweb/vishus12/other-recommend.ajax?houses=`. Price request body includes `language`, `currency`, `series`, `season`, `isNrrApplicable`, optional `ag`, `kmg`, `campaign`, `arrivalTime`, `departureTime`, `selected-agency-offer`, and apartment fields. Booking paths are dynamically returned only after pricing; no booking flow was initiated.
- Contact page has a local house lookup form (`POST` absent in HTML; JS navigation) with `houseid` at `/husnr/`; `/husnr/` itself has form action `/hus`, `houseid`.
- Public favorites view exposes `showAutoappliedCoupon` and `tab=map|compare`, calendar controls, and share tracking params `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`; no favorites mutations performed.

Authentication surfaces:
- `/login.html` links to `/owner2` and `/agent`.
- `/owner2` redirects to `/own26/casnew/login?service=...&renew=`. Forms: POST `login?service=...` (`houseid`, `pincode`, `login`); POST `newpw` (`houseid`, `ownermail`, `newpw`); POST `newnewpw` (`ownermail`, `newpw`); POST `pwconfirm` (`mail`, `newpw[]`, `pwconfirmation`). Disclosed linked protected routes: `/own26/ownerprofile`, `/own26/ownerprices-next`, `/own26/ownerprices-offer`, `ownershiptransfer`.
- `/agent` redirects to `/agent/cas_pro.php/login?service=...&renew=` with POST body names `houseid`, `pincode`, `login`.

Technologies: custom Java/`cms-java` and HouseCube server-rendered application (embedded script comments); inline JavaScript/XMLHttpRequest; JSON-LD; Google Maps integration; Google Analytics and third-party Bing/Criteo references. Observed response policy: HSTS includeSubDomains and CSP report endpoint `/pubweb/csp-violation`.

Robots lists sensitive-but-public functional prefixes: `/pubweb/booking/`, `/pubweb/SendFormMail/`, `/pubweb/form-mail-captcha/`, `/pubweb/vishus12/calendar`, `/pubweb/vishus12/price`, `/housecube/dancenter18/calendar`, `/housecube/dancenter18/search` and `/housecube/mini10/search`. These were recorded only; none were exercised.

e4f0ca.title: G6 Hospitality wildcard surface map
e4f0ca.content:
Read-only discovery within `https://*.g6hospitality.com/` found two reachable in-scope hosts.

## `www.g6hospitality.com`
- `GET /` → `301 Location: https://g6hospitality.com/` (the destination apex was not fetched because the approved scope is wildcard subdomains only). Headers identify Cloudflare, WordPress/`X-Redirect-By: WordPress`, WP Engine, HSTS preload, `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.
- `GET /robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/sitemap_index.xml`, `/.well-known/security.txt`, `/favicon.ico`, `/manifest.json` → Cloudflare `403`; no route inventory was exposed.
- Evidence journal: `d9a2d115-276c-484f-91ca-790207874312`, `7fbb989e-eda5-4310-a715-fd113291c6de`, `bc971cc1-f11d-4af1-ba60-ca605d6398d7`.

## `franchise.g6hospitality.com`
- `GET /` → 200 Next.js application served by Netlify (`Server: Netlify`, `X-Powered-By: Next.js`, durable/edge cache). Title: `Hotel Franchise Fit Review | Motel 6 & Studio 6`.
- Public routes: `/`, `/thank-you` (200, title `Property Review Received | G6 Hospitality`); root anchors `#top`, `#brands`, `#faq`. Tracking query observed: `utm_source` accepted and returns the root page.
- Indexing files return 404: `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/sitemap_index.xml`, `/manifest.json`, `/.well-known/security.txt`.
- Static assets include Next chunks under `/_next/static/chunks/` (page-specific `0zrpuo5r3awn2.js`), font files and images in `/images/optimized/`.
- Bundle-disclosed in-scope workflow (not invoked): `POST /api/property-review`, JSON body `{ involvement, propertyType, hotelName, country, city, region, roomCount, primaryInterest, decisionTimeline, franchiseExpiry, openingTimeline, fullName, businessEmail, phone, website, language, locale, sourcePage, ...n4() }`; client redirects to `/thank-you` on success and logs GTM event `g6_property_review_submitted`. Conditional fields: `franchiseExpiry` only for a currently branded property; `openingTimeline` only for under-construction hotel. `website` is a hidden honeypot. No form was opened or submitted.
- Bundle also discloses client-side Google Places calls for city autocomplete/details with US/Canada region restriction; the external API was not contacted.
- GTM container identifier in source: `GTM-WDSH3B3Q`; footer has external links to Motel 6, Studio 6, and the apex G6 site, none were followed to remain in scope.
- Evidence journal: root `4dc22721-6cf1-4ad4-ad3e-b90fef9a51a1`; page bundle `341f8284-614c-401f-8439-dcfb8ffaf71b`; confirmation route `5b09cc81-9e0b-423c-a78a-83c58c3fff4a`.

## Host discovery gap
A bounded common-name pass found only `www` and `franchise` reachable. Other candidate names (including careers/jobs/investor/support/portal/api/partner plus corporate-service candidates) returned proxy 502/connection failure or timeout. Since external CT/search services and the apex redirect destination are out of scope, the wildcard cannot be exhaustively enumerated from available in-scope evidence.

134018.title: Belvilla wildcard public surface map
134018.content:
## Scope and evidence
Read-only discovery performed only through proxy for `https://*.belvilla.com/`. Raw proxy journal IDs: consumer root `3e413428-2425-48c1-b9cc-ffbab586318f`; loaded JS `437f93e7-f40a-4c84-8a8f-9f4555b7ca29`, `25391dbc-e0a1-427a-acc7-c7b53b466a57`, `2ecc3d90-341f-4137-9858-7eea02e64457`, `2df4d874-75f8-4de1-a1fa-a4d1aa9b9989`, `e1857eb2-d77f-4f09-8ef6-4edfa4fdea24`; public API `c210b7d5-c4b0-4614-92c8-ed4cb82f46fc`; country/search `b74a533b-2c80-45ee-a415-f83a113a6bf1`, `b6ea0331-6d5b-4c9d-91c1-313a8b9bce3a`; partner `7ac4b1ce-8b13-42b9-bc22-060ad92777be`; rental login `c4c30d69-845a-458b-949a-0224a4571db9`.

## Discovered hosts
- `www.belvilla.com`: consumer vacation-rental SPA/PWA (React bundles; server header showed Prism Nginx). Root and public country/search pages returned 200.
- `partner.belvilla.com`: Next.js + React/Material UI owner-acquisition funnel. `/en/` responds 308 -> `/en` (200). Relevant bundle request IDs: `a5de4be5-f8f7-43df-92ed-2ae0eefc03a5`, `12c9349e-9064-41f8-9b9c-e38a5504e84b`.
- `rental.belvilla.com`: owner portal, `/` 302 -> `/login` 200; login HTML contains a conventional Laravel-style `POST https://rental.belvilla.com/login` form with `_token`, `fragment`, `lang`, `email`, and `password` inputs. Form was not submitted.
- `ho.belvilla.com`: linked on consumer home page, but root fetch reached proxy 502. It remains a discovery gap.

## Consumer routes and query surface
- Confirmed 200: `/`, `/holiday-homes-netherlands/`, `/search/?filters[country_id]=143&guests=2&location=Netherlands&searchType=country`, `/api/pwa/homepage`.
- Search query keys observed in first-party links/client markup: `checkin`, `checkout`, `children`, `country`, `coupon`, `filters[country_id]`, `filters[property_type]`, `filters[amenities]`, `flexibleDaysCount`, `guests`, `infants`, `isTravellingWithPets`, `location`, `pets`, `rooms`, `rooms_config`, `searchType`, `showMap`, `showSearchElements`, `sort`, `sortOrder`, `locale`.
- Published consumer content paths: `/hotels/`, `/hotels-germany/` plus regional subroutes; `/holiday-cottage-belgium/`, `/holiday-cottage-groups/`, `/holiday-cottage-netherlands/`, `/holiday-homes-croatia/`, `/holiday-homes-italy/`, `/holiday-homes/netherlands/private-pool/`; `/certainty/`, `/faq/`, `/privacy-policy/`, `/terms/`, `/travel-agencies/`, `/business/partner/`, `/service/*`, `/sitemaps/countries-p0/`.
- Redirect: `/service/faq/` 301 -> `/gi/faq/` (200). `/rent-my-holiday-home/` currently returned 404 despite a client-side link.
- Public `GET /api/pwa/homepage` response includes `upcoming_booking_exists` and a widget descriptor. Its `data_url` points to `https://bff.oyorooms.com/v1/getNearby`, which is outside this child scope and was not accessed.

## Published sitemap/robots coverage
- `robots.txt` lists `/booking_v3/`, `/checkout`, `/booking/`, `/property/*`, `/search2`, `/search-old`, `/kws`, `/content/`, and `/aj_windows/travelagencies/` as excluded from crawling; these are candidate route families only, not tested.
- Published XML documents: `/blog/sitemap_index.xml` -> `/blog/post-sitemap.xml`, `/blog/page-sitemap.xml`; `/sitemap/country-sitemap.xml` lists 20 country landing pages (Austria, Belgium, Croatia, Curacao, Czech Republic, Denmark, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, UK). Blog post sitemap enumerates public `/blog/<slug>/` articles.
- `/sitemap.xml` references out-of-scope `www.oyorooms.com` sitemaps; no off-scope follow-up occurred. `/sitemap_index.xml` returned 403. Legacy feed `/static/feeds/google_sitemaps/v2/bvdir_en_wwwcom.xml` redirected (301) to a malformed/404 destination.

## Client-side API/routes (static references, not invoked)
- Consumer JS exposes `/api/pwa/homepage` (confirmed GET) plus endpoint names: `authenticate`, `authenticateV2`, `authenticateV3`, `bookingCancellationReasons/`, `bookingPropertMeta`, `checkHotelAvailability`, `forgotPassword`, `generateBy`, `getHotelData`, `getHotelDetailUrlSeo2Dot0`, `getSeoContent`, `hotelrating/`, `loginOptions`, `policy-check`, `referral/deeplink`, `resetPassword`, `shortlisted-hotels-list`, `shortlisthotel`, `signup`, `slOauth`, `slVerified`, `slVerify`, `tpl/apple`, `updateUserProfile`, `v1/checkoutPage`, `validate-wizard-coupon`, `validateTravelAgentCode`, `verification`, `verifyDonation`, `yoImageUpload`, `shortlists`, `shortlists/count`.
- Consumer client route references include `/search`, `/login`, `/my-booking`, `/booking/:bookingId`, `/booking/:bookingId/save-card`, `/booking/save-card`, `/booking-paid`, `/bookings/`, `/wishlist`, `/wishlist/:wishlistCode`, `/saved-hotels`, `/accountdetails`, `/accountdetails/oyomoney`, `/upgrade-booking/:bookingId`, `/user-ratings/:bookingId`, `/deals/:dealId`, `/deals/:dealName`, `/referral`, `/reset-password`, `/service/newsletter-signout`. These are static bundle strings and may include shared OYO app code; none were exercised.
- Partner bundle explicitly implements `POST /api/lead/save` and adds request header `X-Host-Domain`; it provides read-only location helpers `GET /api/location/autocomplete?input=`, `GET /api/location/geocode?address=`, and `GET /api/location/reverse-geocode?lat=&lng=`. The lead submission was not called. Partner contact inputs displayed: name, email address, mobile number; its property form uses house/apartment and location data.

## Technologies
Consumer: React client app/PWA, bundled desktop JS, Cookiebot, service worker route `/service-worker-desktop.js`, manifest `/manifest-belvilla-global.json`, and Prism Nginx response marker. Partner: Next.js (`/_next/static/...`) with React and Material UI. Rental login: server-rendered form with CSRF token.

No vulnerability testing, authentication, POST submission, account creation, external-host follow-up, or state modification was performed.

Root form/search client has observed GET parameters: `checkin`, `checkout`, `country_id`, `filters[city_id]`, `flexibleDaysCount`, `guests`, `isLatLngSearch`, `location`, `ratePlan[id]`, `ratePlan[type]`, `ratePlan[values]`, `rooms_config`, `searchType`, `showMap`. Contact form (`/contactus/`) contains required booking ID and email inputs. Bundle logic associates fields `bookingId`, `email` with POST-like authentication request body keys `password`, `email`, `devise_role=Consumer_Guest`, `mode=EMAIL` and query `source`; no request was sent.

JS-disclosed same-origin API namespace includes: `/api/pwa/`, `authenticate`, `authenticateV2`, `authenticateV3`, `bookingCancellationReasons/`, `bookingPropertMeta`, `checkHotelAvailability`, `forgotPassword`, `generateBy`, `getHotelData`, `getHotelDetailUrlSeo2Dot0`, `getSeoContent`, `homepage`, `hotelrating/{id}`, `loginOptions`, `policy-check`, `referral/deeplink`, `resetPassword`, `shortlisted-hotels-list`, `shortlisthotel`, `shortlists`, `shortlists/count`, `signup`, `slOauth`, `slVerified`, `slVerify`, `tpl/apple`, `updateUserProfile`, `validate-wizard-coupon`, `validateTravelAgentCode`, `verification`, `verifyDonation`, `yoImageUpload`. Explicit GET uses observed for `hotelrating/{id}`, `shortlists`, `shortlists/count`; dynamic self-service request parameter names include `bookingId`, `country_code`, `source`, and booking-list keys `fields`, `additional_fields`, `format_response[batch][offset]`, `format_response[batch][count]`, `format_response[sort_params][sort_on]`, `format_response[sort_params][ascending]`, `status`, `filters[status]`, `user_mode[]`, `page_type`, `app_client`.

Assets: root bundles `runtime`, `externalvendor`, `common`, `commoncss`, `widgetizedHome`, `main`; route chunks `loginAuth`, `selfServe`, `staticPage`. Technologies evident: React/Webpack client, Node/Express-style `connect.sid` session cookie and ETags, Akamai (headers), PWA manifest. `robots.txt` permits crawling and references apex sitemap, while `www` serves the sitemap directly (37 URLs: home, `/gb/`, 35 properties).
